notes.title: "Most Wanted" Update - 6 Days Left
notes.notes:
Dear players,

There are only a few days left to finish the campaign and we want to show you more details about the incredible “Most Wanted Ghost” reward. It would be great if you don't miss the opportunity to be eternal in Eden Genesis.

What is the “Most Wanted Ghost” reward in Eden Genesis?

During the game, Leah will get access to the Eden Genesis central system where the data of the most wanted and dangerous Ghosts on the network is stored. High-ranking hackers whose reward would grant millions to anyone offering information about them. Thanks to this reward you will be one of these Ghosts, becoming part of the game and its story.

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44789401/97d412dc32efa7abc40699a87762664331f840ab.jpg

How is the “Most Wanted Ghost” card created?

Our team will ask you for an image of yourself or even a pet, as well as characteristics of the image, references or details that allow us to create together a memorable Ghost file. Since a picture says more than a thousand words, here are some examples.

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44789401/273f412062843a935d4fd8732c890ef56a71928d.jpg

They look amazing, right? Well, it is only possible to be a Ghost in Eden Genesis and become part of our game forever through the “Most Wanted Ghost” reward, whether in its Early or Standard mode. You will also get a Collector's Edition and the digital version of the game, besides the soundtrack and other stuff…

There are only a few days left... We rely on your support to reach the next stretch goal and make Eden Genesis an even better game with your contribution.

See Now Reward "Most Wanted Ghost"

We are preparing more news for the upcoming days, so stay tuned because the last few days will be frantic.

Thanks for your support!

notes.title: Patch Notes 3.0.001
notes.notes:
Base game

Fixed a bug where metal platforms would get stuck in the battle against the Phoenix
Removed a prompt that appeared behind some map vendors
You can now attack with the Katana vertically up and down when playing with the keyboard
Katana cooldown time has been adjusted: 0.1s -> 0.3s

Virtuoso DLC

The Erudite achievement can be unlocked when you complete the base game quests (including "Pit of the Damned") + the "Virtuoso" one
The no-hit achievement can now be unlocked when facing the sword in Boss Rush mode
Fixed an issue where fogs of war would disappear from games started when playing the DLC
Fixed a bug that allowed skill points to be duplicated in Boss Rush mode
Fixed an issue where the King of Darkness would get stuck when healing in Mythic
Fixed a bug in the Sword fight in mythic where the King of Darkness would sometimes disappear when entering portals

Easy Anti Cheat has been removed

Aeternum Game Studios has decided to remove the EAC feature from Aeterna Noctis to ensure full accessibility to players and also in response to the demands of the community.

We understand that the addition of this functionality has not been well-received by certain sectors, and has also posed a problem for those players who for accessibility reasons have not been able to enjoy the title.

Instead, we have designed our own anti-cheat system that only applies to the leaderboards of the timed trials. This way, the stats obtained will remain legitimate without affecting the rest of the content of Aeterna Noctis, that is, gameplay elements and features that are single-player.

We have always listened to the community. This has been one of our hallmarks as a dev team. It is thanks to your suggestions that the Aeterna Universe has never stopped including improvements based on player feedback. The message was clear, EAC was an addition that was not liked and now it is history.

We would be very grateful if, just as you have expressed your disagreement with the inclusion of EAC, now that it has been removed from the title, you would also share it on the Steam forum and the rest of the networks, so that the news reaches all players. We trust that this decision will allow Aeterna Noctis to be valued solely for its playable values.

Long live the King of Darkness!

notes.title: Aeternum Game Studios release schedule
notes.notes:
https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/39578084/1edde10a5cb0655d17e9862f87d76a2d24885af0.png

It's been a week since the last Aeternum Game Studios showcase! 

The event featured interesting news about the future of the franchise and the studio's new projects. In addition to delving into the mechanics and gameplay that make Summum Aeterna a unique Roguelite, we also confirmed a new DLC for Aeterna Noctis coming later this year, and Eden Genesis, a new IP apart from the Universe Aeterna.

Let's take a look at the next releases for 2023 and 2024:

- Summum Aeterna: A Roguelite game and prequel to Aeterna Noctis. The game includes the so-called "seed mechanic" a tool that allows players to set up runs on demand by adding and removing genes. Since the germinated worlds from seeds never repeat themselves, they will always be unique, and if you add the influences, everything will be even more chaotic. Each run promises to be different from the last! Coming to PC and consoles on September 2023

- Aeterna Noctis "Virtuoso":  The next DLC for Aeterna Noctis is a boss rush that will allow players to once again face the challenging bosses of our Metroidvania. Undoubtedly, one of the most anticipated features by the community!

- Aeterna Lucis: The sequel to Aeterna Noctis. Soon we'll share more details about it ;)

- Eden Genesis: A new IP, a new project apart from the well-established Aeterna Universe. “Eden Genesis” is the name of this mysterious title, a cyberpunk-style adventure.

Excited enough?

notes.title: Release date confirmed for the Aeterna Noctis DLC and Summum Aeterna
notes.notes:
Good news for the followers of the King of Darkness!

On May 22 of this year, the next DLC for our fast-paced Metroidvania will be available for free on all platforms, adding dozens of hours of combat and exploration. The new trailer shows everything players can expect from this new downloadable content:

[previewyoutube=jT5XG1Cp6_g;full][/previewyoutube]

In just one month, Steam, Nintendo, PlayStation and Xbox players will be able to download the DLC completely free. Among the features that the "Pit of the Damned" brings, there are two new game areas that expand the gaming experience. Access to these new levels is completely organic, both are integrated naturally with the other areas, being accessible from the first hours of the game.

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/39578084/68d36a2673c5de182e0801b5c73c0f48d2a7171a.png

The DLC also introduces a new roster of enemies never seen before for the King of Darkness to face in order to uncover the secrets of the new areas, including new boss fights. The "Pit of the Damned" expands the list of available gems by adding 6 new ones, some of them created at the request of our community ;)

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/39578084/40774da6e2799fc784f21320ddf76971caad500e.png

Another of the most important additions in this DLC are the timed trials with an interesting multiplayer and cross-platform function. Players will be allowed to compete against each other to make their names stand out among the world statistics. You will have to work hard to get the best score on each trial and enter the top 10!

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/39578084/7c626254ec096d6c883c896bbfba0b3d5901e8f4.png

The good news for the Aeterna Universe community does not end here. Summum Aeterna, the prequel to Aeterna Noctis, will arrive on all platforms simultaneously next September with its final version v1.0. The frenetic Roguelite starring his dark majesty is getting closer to ending its Early Access period, and tomorrow, April 19, the next big update for Summum Aeterna will be released, a patch loaded with new content.

2023 is going to be a great year for the Aeterna Universe and our gaming community!

notes.title: New update with accessibility options and improvements to combat and movement!
notes.notes:
Aeterna Noctis Patch Notes v1.1.000

Gameplay:

 Improved collision calculation for sword and scythe attacks
 Added a new combat assist system to improve the attack rate of the sword and scythe
 Increased the jump assist window time when falling from a platform by 50% to improve the King of Darkness reaction time
 Improved the ground jump assist window to prevent it from consuming the double jump if the King is too close to a platform
 A new assistance system has been included to improve the calculation of side collisions when hitting platforms
 Balanced the life of some Bosses in "Aeterna" Mode
 Balanced the health of the four doomsday dragons from 1200 to 800 health
 Slugs will now not explode instantly if the damage they take exceeds 100% of their health

Weapons:

 The cost of the following weapons has been adjusted:
Ax: 30 -> 20 blood points
Spear: 30 -> 20 blood points
Katana Slash: 35 -> 20 blood points
Katana Feint: 35 -> 25 blood points
 The damage done by the blood arrow has been doubled

Gems:

 The effect of the "Time Sapphire" gem has been improved, including a reduction in the fall speed of the King of Darkness for the duration of its effect.
 "Whetstone" gem effect increased from 10% to 25% damage
 "Light Alloy" gem effect increased from 5% to 10% critical chance
 Increased the effect of the "Minor Enhancer" gem from 20% to 35% critical damage
 Increased the effect of the "Philosopher's Stone" gem from double to triple
 "Imperator" gem effect increased from 50% to 100%
 Increased the effect of the "Sagittarius Eye" gem from 50% to 100%
 Increased the effect of the "Thirsty Ruby" gem from 25% to 50%

Upgrade Tree:

 The "Guardian Angel" skill node has been redesigned:
Grants 100% revive on death, and heals the King of Darkness for 100% health. Recharges each time you are defeated. Does not work against spikes or traps.
Added a "Guardian Angel" indicator on the HUD The effect of the initial 6 nodes has been doubled to adjust the player's progress more correctly to the difficulty curve
 The effect of the "Combat Charge" node has been improved from 1 to 2 seconds and from 20% to 30% damage
 "On the Verge of Death" node effect increased from 20% to 50% damage
 "Iron Health" node effect increased from 20% to 30% damage
 Improved the effect of the "Quick Arrow" node by removing the 1 second effect duration time, now the next shot after a fast recovery will have no ammo cost
 Improved the effect of the "Bloody Death" node by increasing the spilt blood from 1 to 2 units
 The effect of the "Doctor" node has been improved, now the effects of the King of Darkness cures are twice as powerful

Achievements:

 Fixed various platform bugs where sometimes achievements/trophies were not being delivered correctly despite having met the requirements. The achievements obtained by the players will be delivered automatically when opening the menu within a game (It is possible that some achievements are not delivered correctly if the platform did not register them as completed internally at the time of obtaining it)

Various improvements:

 Fixed a bug where the "Potions" and "Dark Portal" indicators on the HUD would not properly disappear when the King was approaching
 Fixed a bug where when changing language all texts were not translated correctly until changing scene
 Fixed a bug where the Phoenix could sometimes be defeated in phase 2 preventing the player from getting the reward correctly
 Fixed a bug where progress would sometimes not be saved correctly when beating the last boss
 Fixed a bug where the lost experience was sometimes not correctly refunded when retrieving the soul
 Fixed a bug where the fog of war map save files were sometimes corrupted causing the map to restart
 Fixed a bug that made the King of Darkness "Invincible" when he died via the Eye of the Oracle
 Fixed a bug where some platforms were not displaying correctly in "Royal Stairs" on "Aeterna" difficulty
 Improved performance and memory consumption overall on all platforms
 Fixed various localization bugs
 Fixed a bug where turning off vibration in the options menu would cause some actions to still vibrate
 Fixed a bug where loading game in "Temple of Kings 3" would cause the camera to go out of bounds
 Fixed a bug that allowed the graphics quality to be changed on some consoles
 Fixed a bug where throne indicator arrows on the map would get stuck
 Fixed a bug where "Dark Portal" could be performed in the final boss battle
 Fixed a bug where progress after the final boss battle would sometimes not be saved correctly
 Fixed a bug where the shadow effect of thrones would incorrectly persist after standing up
 Fixed a bug where the soul would sometimes not recover correctly when stolen by enemies in the "Abyss"
 Fixed a bug where sometimes the "Undersea Fortress" Teleporter would not move you to the correct position when going to "A" level
 Fixed a bug where after beating the v1 AI you could go outside the map boundaries
 Fixed a bug where it was sometimes not possible to retrieve your soul when it was stolen from you by an enemy
 Fixed a bug where the graphic for the door on the first floor of the "Wasteland West Tower" would not appear after revisiting the area

notes.title: New patch featuring a new game mode!
notes.notes:
New patch featuring a new game mode!

- Aeterna Mode: new game mode with redesigned platforms and puzzles for a more accessible experience focused on action and exploration

- Noctis Mode: the studio original version

The patch is available now on Steam, Epic Games Store and PlayStation 5!  It will be ready for Xbox Series in two days, the platform must approve it first.


Main notes for the patch v1.0.005:

- The new game mode "Aeterna" (reduced difficulty and redesign of platforms-puzzles) has been implemented. At the moment, there will be no achievements in this mode but we are working on it.

- The new game mode "Noctis" (Current Difficulty) has been implemented

- It is possible to switch between the two difficulty modes at any time from the "pause menu"

- A "Skull" indicator has been implemented in the HUD when playing in "Noctis" mode.

- Fixed a bug where some players would lose the fog of war from the map when restarting the game

- Fixed a bug whereby the game was not saved correctly, causing rollbacks to previous points in the game (PS5)

- The performance of volumetric lights has been improved

- Loading between scenes has been improved to optimize the memory used in the transition

- Small visual bugs have been fixed

- Enemies have been balanced in both difficulty modes to better match game progression

- Some King's weapons have been balanced in both difficulty modes to better match game progression

- The number of indicators on the map for collectibles and quests has been increased

- The number of thrones has been increased in both difficulty modes to facilitate exploration

- The gold obtained in the chests has been increased

- Errors in obtaining some achievements have been corrected (Achievements already completed will be given to players when accessing the progress menu)

- Checkpoints have been increased in some sections

- A bug that allowed unlimited money to be obtained through the "collection" has been corrected

- Fixed a bug that modified button actions when using PS4 controller

- The action "Interact" has been included in the remapping of controls, this will not modify the interaction notice prompt.
